Thank you for issuing the bidding docume: Thank you for issuing the bidding document of this ERP project. The overall structure of the document is clear, the evaluation criteria are clear, the functional requirements cover a wide range, and a lot of solid work has been done in sorting out the requirements. We have accumulated many years of project experience in the field of ERP implementation in the global banking industry. After studying, we put forward the following opinions from a practical point of view for your reference.
The following five aspects are demand, t: The following five aspects are demand, technology, implementation, business, and operation and maintenance.
Performance Metric- \"high Concurrency\": Performance Metric- "high Concurrency" Needs to Be Quantified to a Specific Number
There are many qualitative descriptions: There are many qualitative descriptions such as "high concurrency", "real-time monitoring" and "high performance" in the bidding documents, but no quantifiable performance baseline has been given. This is a common hidden danger in ERP projects: in the UAT acceptance stage, the supply and demand sides are prone to disagree on the criteria for "reaching the standard", which often leads to contract disputes.
It is suggested that quantitative indica: It is suggested that quantitative indicators should be supplemented in the chapter of non-functional requirements. The following is our estimation based on the scale of 1500 + employees of the whole bank, which can be adjusted by your company according to the actual business scale:
95% of general query transaction respons: 95% of general query transaction response time ≤ 3 seconds; Complex report generation ≤ 30 seconds
Support no less than 300 users to operat: Support no less than 300 users to operate online at the same time (estimated by 1/5 of the peak concurrency)
Annual availability rate of production e: Annual availability rate of production environment ≥ 99.5% (annual unplanned downtime does not exceed 43.8 hours)
With the quantitative benchmark, the acc: With the quantitative benchmark, the acceptance stage can use data to speak, rather than relying on subjective judgment.
System Integration-Unclear Interface Bou: System Integration-Unclear Interface Boundary Is the Primary Risk Point of ERP Project
In the requirements description, it is m: In the requirements description, it is mentioned many times that it is necessary to connect with the "core banking system" and "third-party business system" (such as RI014 and BP102), but the complete list of the connection system, the type of the interface protocol and the requirements for the frequency of data exchange are not specified.
It should be emphasized that according t: It should be emphasized that according to our project experience, system integration is the most controversial part of ERP project. Once the interface boundary is blurred, the quotation caliber of each bidder can not be aligned-some bidders may underestimate the integration workload and encounter difficulties in actual implementation after winning the bid at a low price. In addition, if the interface opening capability (the number of APIs and the open scope of the data dictionary) of your company's core banking system is not evaluated in advance, the joint debugging progress in the implementation stage may be affected.
It is recommended to add a \"system inte: It is recommended to add a "system integration interface matrix" in the requirements specification, at least listing: name of external system to be connected, connection direction (one-way push/two-way synchronization), data exchange frequency (real-time/quasi-real-time/batch timing), interface protocol preference (RESTful API/SOAP/middleware/database direct connection). At the same time, it is suggested that your company conduct an internal evaluation on the interface opening capability of the core banking system, and provide the results to the bidder, so that the quotations of each company are comparable.
Data Migration-The Caliber of \"free Ful: Data Migration-The Caliber of "free Full Migration" Needs to Be Unified
Section d of the service specification o: Section d of the service specification of the bidding document mentions that "priority should be given to the migration of basic static data and account balance data", and asks whether the bidder can "complete the migration of full historical data free of charge and free of construction period". The starting point of this requirement is understandable, but there are several key issues that need to be clarified at the operational level.
The migration scope involves three dimen: The migration scope involves three dimensions: historical data years (nearly 3 years/5 years/all since CCB), data module scope (only HR and finance, or covering all modules such as procurement and assets), data format and data quality status of the old system. The information is not clear, and the bidder's commitment to "free full migration" is bound to be inconsistent-some bidders will quote the migration workload separately, and some of them will be included in the total price, which can not be compared horizontally in bid evaluation.
In addition, the hidden risks of data mi: In addition, the hidden risks of data migration should not be underestimated. During the implementation phase, it is often found that the quality of old data is much lower than expected, and the amount of data cleaning may approach or even exceed the system configuration itself.
1) First priority (must be transferred):: 1) First priority (must be transferred): organization structure, personnel master data, account balance table, and supplier/customer master data;
2) Second priority (migration recommende: 2) Second priority (migration recommended): financial sub-ledger in recent 3 years and HR salary history in recent 2 years;
3) Third priority (optional): Earlier hi: 3) Third priority (optional): Earlier history details and attachments.
\"Historical full data migration\" is re: "Historical full data migration" is recommended to be quoted separately as an optional value-added service item and not mixed into the main quotation. If your company can provide the data dictionary of the old system or the desensitized data sample, the workload evaluation of the bidder will be more accurate.
Attendance Terminal-Deployment Details N: Attendance Terminal-Deployment Details Need to Be Supplemented
The ETAMS attendance system involves fin: The ETAMS attendance system involves fingerprint, face recognition and smart card, which are used by 1500 + employees of the whole bank, but the following key information is missing: the number of attendance terminals to be deployed in each branch/office, the network connection mode between the terminal and the ERP system (wired/wireless/offline mode), and whether the equipment needs to adapt to special environmental conditions (such as high temperature, dust, etc.). Whether IP65 rated dust and water resistance is required).
These parameters look like details, but: These parameters look like details, but they directly affect hardware acquisition costs and deployment scenarios. If it is not clear, the hardware quotation of each bidder will be very different and not comparable.
Deployment Architecture-This Item Needs: Deployment Architecture-This Item Needs to Be Oriented at the Tender Stage
The bidding document does not specify th: The bidding document does not specify the deployment mode of ERP system (localized deployment/private cloud/hybrid cloud), but only mentions "three environments of production, disaster recovery and testing". Different deployment modes have significant differences in hardware investment, operation and maintenance requirements, disaster recovery costs and expansion flexibility, which should not be determined until the implementation stage.
Based on the data sovereignty and regula: Based on the data sovereignty and regulatory requirements of the banking industry, localized deployment and remote redundancy of disaster recovery sites are relatively safe architecture choices-core data should not leave the network boundary within the bank. Of course, the final scheme shall be determined in combination with the actual conditions of your data center (machine room area, power capacity, network bandwidth). It is recommended to provide these infrastructure information to the bidder so as to accurately formulate the hardware adaptation scheme.
If your company is still in the evaluati: If your company is still in the evaluation stage, you can also ask the bidder to provide the comparative analysis of at least two deployment modes (cost, operation and maintenance, security and scalability) in the scheme as a reference for decision-making.
Customization Development Strategy- \"ze: Customization Development Strategy- "zero Customization" Needs to Be Treated Differently
The tender document repeatedly emphasize: The tender document repeatedly emphasizes "zero customization or very little customization development", and this principle is in the right direction-the core business processes (general ledger, a/P, a/R, procurement) should indeed adopt ERP standard functions. However, some of the localization requirements involved in the requirements, such as Amharic support, adaptation of local tax regulations, and integration of FAYDA national identity authentication, cannot be directly met through standard functions in the global mainstream ERP products, and a certain degree of customization is inevitable.
If \"CC (satisfaction after customizatio: If "CC (satisfaction after customization)" in the scoring mechanism is only 1 point, the bidder may deliberately avoid these localization needs that really need moderate customization, and be vague in the response, which will affect the integrity and landing of the final scheme.
It is recommended to divide the customiz: It is recommended to divide the customization requirements into two types of management:
Reasonable customization items: Amharic: Reasonable customization items: Amharic localization, local tax law adaptation, FAYDA integration, etc., which belong to the general customization of the industry, and the weight of the rating should be reasonably reflected (2-3 points are recommended for CC);
Custom items should be avoided: core bus: Custom items should be avoided: core business processes must strictly follow ERP standard functionality.
At the same time, the bidder is required: At the same time, the bidder is required to submit the "Customized Development List and Impact Assessment" in the scheme, explaining the customization content, workload, impact on version upgrade and long-term maintenance cost one by one.
Performance Testing-The Qualification an: Performance Testing-The Qualification and Scenario of the Testing Organization Needs to Be Clarified
PS002 requires \"an independent performa: PS002 requires "an independent performance benchmark company to issue an authorization report", but does not specify the qualification requirements of the testing agency, nor does it define the scope of the test scenario.
Two suggestions: one is to clarify the q: Two suggestions: one is to clarify the qualification threshold of testing institutions, such as ISPL certification, SPEC membership, or internationally recognized qualifications of the same level; Secondly, the test scenarios should not be limited to laboratory conditions, but should cover the real peak scenarios of banking business-high concurrent entry during the financial closing period at the end of the month/year, the centralized attendance punch period of 1500 + employees in the whole bank, and the system load of batch salary calculation and report generation running at the same time. The closer the test scenario is to the actual operating conditions, the higher the reference value of the test conclusion is.
Duration-Need to Set a Clear Time Anchor: Duration-Need to Set a Clear Time Anchor
The bidding document requires the bidder: The bidding document requires the bidder to propose its own implementation schedule (Section 3.3.1-3.3.2), but it does not give the expected launch date or the upper limit of the overall construction period. This means that the duration commitment of each bidder may vary from 9 months to 24 months, and there is no unified comparison benchmark in the evaluation.
It is suggested to define an online time: It is suggested to define an online time window, such as "completing the core module online within 12-18 months after the contract comes into effect". At the same time, it is recommended to adopt the * * phased online strategy * *: in the first stage, the three core modules of finance, HR and procurement are prioritized; in the second stage, non-core modules such as fleet management and knowledge base are deployed. 提交给 institutions with high business continuity requirements such as banks, the risk of launching a full module at one time is too high.
The payment schedule is suggested to be: The payment schedule is suggested to be bound with key milestones: 20% of business blueprint confirmation → 30% of system configuration completion → 20% of UAT passing → 20% of formal launch → 10% of final acceptance. This arrangement not only protects your company's rights and interests, but also provides performance incentives for suppliers.
INSA Safety Evaluation-Sufficient Period: INSA Safety Evaluation-Sufficient Periods Should Be Reserved and Contingency Plan Should Be Set
The requirement description requires tha: The requirement description requires that "the ERP system must pass the INSA security assessment before it can be formally put into production", and the supplier shall bear all the repair costs. This requirement itself is reasonable, but according to our project experience, there is great uncertainty in the queuing cycle and rectification cycle of INSA evaluation, which may become the bottleneck of the critical path of the project launch.
It is recommended to reserve an INSA ass: It is recommended to reserve an INSA assessment period of * * not less than 2 months * * in the project plan (including queuing, preliminary test, rectification and retest). The contract shall specify the handling mechanism for the failure to pass the evaluation: if the supplier fails to pass the evaluation for the first time, the supplier shall complete the rectification within the agreed period (such as 30 days) and bear the cost; if the supplier still fails to pass the rectification, the contract change or withdrawal clause shall be initiated. In addition, it is recommended that suppliers be allowed to conduct safety self-test and pre-scan in advance during the development phase, identify and repair safety hazards in advance, and shorten the formal evaluation cycle.
Switching Between New and Old Systems-Pa: Switching Between New and Old Systems-Parallel Operation Period Can Not Be Omitted
We think this is the most important part: We think this is the most important part of the whole switching scheme. Banking business continuity requirements are extremely high, direct switching, no parallel transition period, once the new system is abnormal, the daily office of the whole bank will be affected immediately, especially the financial and salary accounting module.
It is suggested that a parallel operatio: It is suggested that a parallel operation period of not less than one month should be arranged, and the new and old systems should be operated simultaneously to verify the data accuracy of the new system based on the data of the old system. At the same time, it is necessary to formulate a detailed rollback plan and specify the following elements: the criteria for determining the success of switching (for example, the data difference rate in the parallel period is lower than agreed threshold), the trigger conditions for rollback (for example, the data difference rate of key business exceeds 2%), the rollback operation process and the responsible person. The parallel operation period should be taken as a necessary link before the formal launch and be included in the acceptance preconditions.
Key Personnel – Stability Assurance Requ: Key Personnel – Stability Assurance Requires Contract-Level Constraints
Section 2.2 of the review criteria requi: Section 2.2 of the review criteria requires 8 core personnel, with NBE approval for replacement during implementation. However, it may not be sufficient to set an "approval" threshold. The ERP project cycle is usually more than 12-18 months. Once the project manager and technical leader are replaced halfway, the knowledge gap of the project, the rising cost of communication, and the need to rebuild the established collaborative relationship with your company-these hidden losses often have a greater impact than explicit delay in the construction period.
It is suggested to add the following bin: It is suggested to add the following binding clauses in the contract: the shortest service period commitment of the project manager and the core technical personnel (at least covering the whole project cycle); when the personnel are replaced, the new and old personnel shall be handed over for at least 2 weeks; if the replacement exceeds 2 times within 12 months, the supplier shall pay the agreed proportion of liquidated damages. In addition, it is suggested that the bidder is required to provide the retention rate data of its core technical team in the past two years as a reference for the evaluation of personnel stability.
Software Licensing – Long-Term Total Cos: Software Licensing – Long-Term Total Cost of Ownership Needs to Be Locked in Early
The technical specification requires tha: The technical specification requires that "the permanent license shall be provided first; if the permanent license cannot be provided, the complete software license service for three years shall be provided". However, there is no agreement on the renewal arrangement after three years: if the subscription system is adopted, how to determine the renewal price? Is the authorization of third-party software (database, middleware) included in the total quotation? If these are not locked in the bidding stage, they will face the risk of uncontrollable cost after three years.
It is suggested that the bidder be requi: It is suggested that the bidder be required to specify the following three items in the quotation: the authorization mode of ERP main products and all supporting components (permanent/subscription); the upper limit commitment of the renewal price after three years under the subscription mode (if the increase does not exceed the annual CPI index); whether the authorization scope and cost of all third-party software have been included in the total quotation. The software license renewal fee and operation and maintenance service fee in the "Four-year Extended Warranty Service Quotation" shall be listed separately so that your company can evaluate the long-term cost structure.
Intellectual Property – Ownership of Cus: Intellectual Property – Ownership of Custom Development Requires Tiered Agreement
\"Customized materials\" and \"customize: "Customized materials" and "customized software" are mentioned in GCC, but the ownership of intellectual property rights is not specified. If this issue is not clarified in advance, it may lead to various disputes in the future: the customization function may not be compatible when the version is upgraded and needs to be repaired at an additional cost; when the supplier is replaced in the future, there may be obstacles to the code handover and knowledge transfer of the customization part; the boundary between the supplier's general platform code and your company's business customization code will gradually blur.
It is suggested that the hierarchical ow: It is suggested that the hierarchical ownership of intellectual property rights should be clearly defined in the contract:
Owned by your company: all codes, config: Owned by your company: all codes, configurations, documents, report templates customized and developed for this project, as well as your company's business data and process design;
Owned by the supplier: the copyright of: Owned by the supplier: the copyright of the underlying platform code, general framework and tool library of the ERP product;
Negotiate together: Industry solution co: Negotiate together: Industry solution components that are based on your business needs but have common value.
When the project is delivered, the suppl: When the project is delivered, the supplier shall provide the complete source code and technical documents of the customized part to ensure that your company has the ability of independent maintenance and secondary development. The obligation to guarantee the compatibility of the customized code in the version upgrade should also be written into the contract.
Personal Data Protection Laws-Compliance: Personal Data Protection Laws-Compliance Requirements Need to Be Specified
The Statement of Requirements mentions t: The Statement of Requirements mentions that the system must comply with the Personal Data Protection Act No.1312 of 2024, but does not list the specific technical requirements of this regulation for the ERP system. This regulation may cover the following aspects: the storage location of personal data (whether it must be stored in Ethiopia), the way in which the data subject's right to query, correct and delete is implemented in the system, the restrictions on cross-border transmission of data, the time limit and process for notification of data breaches.
It is suggested to supplement the specif: It is suggested to supplement the specific technical compliance requirements of the regulation for ERP system in the requirements specification, or provide a link to the original text of the regulation for the bidder to study. A special section shall be set up in the bidding scheme to elaborate the implementation path of the data protection compliance scheme, covering the data classification and classification mechanism, the processing flow of the data subject's right request, the data retention period and automatic destruction mechanism, and the emergency response plan for data leakage.

The bid bond is 2% of the total bid pric: The bid bond is 2% of the total bid price, which can be paid in USD or ETB. However, the project cycle is long, and the ETB exchange rate fluctuation may be more significant. If ETB is paid, the actual guarantee effect of the deposit will be reduced accordingly in case of substantial depreciation during the implementation of the project.
It is recommended that the currency of t: It is recommended that the currency of the margin be consistent with the contract settlement currency. If dual-currency payment is allowed, it is recommended to set up an exchange rate locking mechanism (for example, the exchange rate of the central bank on the deadline for bidding shall prevail). The amount of the Performance Security shall be calculated as a fixed percentage of the Contract Price and shall not be subject to adjustment due to fluctuations in exchange rates.
Knowledge Transfer-Training Effectivenes: Knowledge Transfer-Training Effectiveness Requires Verifiable Acceptance Criteria
The demand description puts forward more: The demand description puts forward more comprehensive requirements for training services, including hierarchical training, delivery of a full set of manuals, etc. However, in the actual project, the training link is most likely to become a mere formality-after the training is completed and the manual is delivered, your team is still unable to deal with routine operation and maintenance problems independently after the end of the warranty period, the system adjustment (such as adding new reports, modifying the approval process) still depends on the supplier, and the operation and maintenance costs continue to be high.
The core of the problem lies in the lack: The core of the problem lies in the lack of acceptance criteria for training effectiveness. It is recommended to set a clear threshold for capability inspection: your technical team can independently complete routine operation and maintenance operations such as daily patrol inspection, user management and permission configuration; Your key users can independently complete business operations such as report design and process configuration.
In terms of training methods, in additio: In terms of training methods, in addition to classroom lectures and paper manuals, it is recommended to arrange practical operation links during UAT testing and parallel operation-your team directly handles problems in real business scenarios under the guidance of suppliers, and completes knowledge internalization in practice.
After the training, there should be an a: After the training, there should be an assessment mechanism. It is recommended to arrange an independent operation and maintenance capability assessment before the end of the warranty period, and your team will independently handle a batch of preset common problems and fault scenarios without the assistance of the supplier as the basis for judging the completion of knowledge transfer.
Extended Warranty Service-Service Conten: Extended Warranty Service-Service Content and Pricing Need to Be Refined
The bidding document requires a quotatio: The bidding document requires a quotation for a four-year extended warranty service. It is recommended to further refine the extended warranty service, at least covering: system fault response SLA (response time, resolution time classification), frequency of regular inspection and health check, scope and cost of version upgrade and patch installation, and service time of user support hotline and remote assistance.
The software license renewal fee and man: The software license renewal fee and manual operation and maintenance service fee in the extended warranty quotation shall be listed separately. These two costs are driven by different factors – the former depends on the vendor's pricing strategy, while the latter depends on the scope of the service and the effort – and a mixed offer is not conducive to your assessment of reasonableness.

The core idea is that the clearer the demand and the clearer the boundary, the more comparable the quotations of the bidders will be, and the less room for disputes in the implementation stage. The purpose of these recommendations is to identify potential risks at the bid evaluation stage, rather than wait until the implementation stage to remedy them.

Overview of Employee Attendance Manageme: Overview of Employee Attendance Management (ETA) Module Technical Solution
As a national sovereign financial instit: As a national sovereign financial institution, the National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) has strict internal control demands on the punctuality compliance governance, flexible scheduling of complex shifts, accurate accounting of multi-category leave and sensitive overtime pay cascading of thousands of bank staff. This module specially constructs a set of unified and integrated time attendance and resource scheduling (ETA) core. The module is based on the transaction-level control of the underlying object-relational mapping (ORM) framework and the high-performance time window overlap detection algorithm, covering the whole life cycle business scenarios such as personnel change file synchronization, multi-modal biometric card punching, change attendance closed-loop audit, dynamic reversal of leave quota and overtime hierarchical control. Through non-intrusive flexible resource calendar parameter arrangement, the system ensures the efficient and autonomous service of employees in the bank, and at the same time, rigidly locks the compliance red line of separation of duties (SoD) in the physical layer of the base, providing NBE with a high-availability, full-chain audit financial time capital governance platform.
Core Function Components and Technology: Core Function Components and Technology Implementation Path
By calling the native mature components: By calling the native mature components of the underlying application software library, this module completely constructs an employee attendance and leave management system that meets the requirements of the central bank for high precision and strong disaster recovery. The following technical implementations are cascaded with the specific business requirements proposed by NBE.
(1) Basic personnel attendance file and: (1) Basic personnel attendance file and dynamic synchronization mechanism The master data integrity of the attendance system depends on the underlying cascade with the core HR module. The system establishes an integrated data bus mapping path in the base layer. Attendance Master File Modeling: The system uses the core employee file model to maintain the structured context including the employee's unique number, real name, Directorate, Team, and technical title. This fits and meets the business requirements of the ETA001 requirement to allow entry of employee information including employee number, name, department, team, and other relevant data. Each attendance account has a unique object identifier pointer in the underlying relational database, which is directly anchored to the underlying main identity table. Automatic cascading of HR transaction: When an employee is transferred across departments, promoted, regularized during probation period, or resigned within the bank, the single update transaction executed by the HR specialist in the core HR module will be broadcast to the attendance archive in milliseconds through the trigger and dependency injection mechanism at the bottom of the database. This fits and conforms to the dynamic update specification in the ETA001 requirement that allows employee data to be modified during transfers, promotions, etc. The system will automatically reset the attendance rule group to which the employee belongs, the superior indicator of the leave approval process, and the corresponding salary settlement ownership, thus fundamentally eliminating the risk of missed attendance or violation of authorization caused by information gaps. Compliance soft deletion and history preservation: In response to NBE audit compliance and data integrity requirements, the system is strictly prohibited from physically clearing the master data of any attendance personnel. When the clerk leaves or the project ends and needs to be written off, the system executes logical soft delete to transpose the underlying status bit to invalid. This adapts and complies with the security directive in the ETA001 requirement to allow employee data to be purged if necessary, while allowing for data traceability. This action will immediately fuse the access permission of the authentication gateway, but the sign-in records, overtime orders and approval links of its historical participation will be permanently physically retained for future reference.
(2) The multi-dimensional punch card dat: (2) The multi-dimensional punch card data acquisition and confirmation communication gateway system constructs an open external communication adaptation layer, which supports the seamless integration of physical boundary punch card hardware and digital application layer. This adapts to and complies with the hardware access standards supporting different check-in and check-out methods such as facial recognition and fingerprint in ETA002 requirements. Data is encrypted in both directions across the transmission link, preventing man-in-the-middle interception or forgery.
